camera.name: CAM_Hero_Reference_Fit
camera.reference_assumptions: Primary upper hero panel, approximate 3.56:1 crop; inferred room width 23 m and nominal eye height 3.05 m.

asset_provenance: Authored studio and terrain plus six selected Poly Haven CC0 assets; source URLs, author metadata, and file hashes are recorded in assets/asset-provenance.json.
limitations: Anatomy and technical screens remain schematic. Terrain is artist-authored. Hero camera remains an inferred fit, not measured calibration.
observed_corrections: Moved embedded capture-platform diffusers outside opaque platform faces.
Reduced flat fill illumination and concealed helper light panels from camera/reflection/transmission rays.
Reduced grazing reflection of the meeting partition while retaining an editable glass shader.
visual_review: Compared v002, v003, and v004 actual PNGs. Corrected oversized terracotta planters and soft mountain ridges in v003. v004 preserves the hero camera and four-zone order, with warmer interior contrast, a blue-hour HDR sky, rugged editable terrain, photographed plant detail, and leather furniture detail.

corrections_after_v003: Fit licensed broadleaf foliage to slim stoneware planters with credible dimensions.
Sharpened alpine ridge geometry and snow breakup.
Graded the dusk sky toward blue-hour through glazing and retained warm interior fixtures.

render_device_selection.evidence: balance_refinement.py enabled only OPTIX devices immediately before the final render; source retains Cycles GPU selection.
